That's... the old school building.
"That's our world. And from now on, it will be your world too."
Without any resistance, my feet rose off the ground.
I would pass through the screen and go there.
To my new world.
Yes, now I understood.
The calm, lovely atmosphere of the old school building.
The masked girl had to be there too.
Somehow, I longed desperately to see her.
Pressing a hand to my fluttering heart, I plunged into that world, shimmering like a heat haze.{p}
